mapper.sql: chart_accounts.id AS id, chart_accounts.parent_id AS parentId, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, chart_account_parent.account_codes AS parentCode, chart_account_parent.account_description AS parentDescription, chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id AS chartAccountTypeId, chart_account_types.name AS chartAccountTypeName, chart_accounts.chart_account_group_id AS chartAccountGroupId, chart_account_groups.name AS chartAccountGroupName, chart_accounts.account_codes AS accountCodes, chart_accounts.account_description AS accountDescription, chart_accounts.manual AS manual, chart_accounts.orcode AS orcode, chart_accounts.pvcode AS pvcode, chart_accounts.is_active AS status, DATE_FORMAT(chart_accounts.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(chart_accounts.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM chart_accounts LEFT JOIN chart_accounts AS chart_account_parent ON chart_account_parent.id = chart_accounts.parent_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = chart_accounts.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = chart_accounts.modified_by LEFT JOIN chart_account_types ON chart_account_types.id = chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id LEFT JOIN chart_account_groups ON chart_account_groups.id = chart_accounts.chart_account_group_id LEFT JOIN chart_account_branches ON chart_account_branches.chart_account_id = chart_accounts.id LEFT JOIN branches ON chart_account_branches.branch_id = branches.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO general_ledgers( `date`, reference, is_retained_earnings, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{accountClosingDateSetting.date}, #{accountClosingDateSetting.reference}, #{accountClosingDateSetting.isRetainedEarnings}, NOW(), #{accountClosingDateSetting.createdBy}, #{accountClosingDateSetting.isActive} );

INSERT INTO general_ledger_details( `general_ledger_id`, `branch_id`, company_id, chart_account_id, `type`, debit, credit, memo, class_id ) VALUES ( #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.generalLedgerId}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.branchId}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.companyId}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.chartAccountId}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.type}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.debit}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.credit}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.memo}, #{accountClosingDateSettingDetail.classId} );
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(credit)-SUM(debit), 0) FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id WHERE gl.is_approve=1 AND gl.is_approve=1 AND gl.is_active=1 AND company_id=#{filter.companyId} AND DATE(`date`) <= DATE(#{filter.date}) AND gld.chart_account_id IN ( SELECT id FROM chart_accounts WHERE is_active=1 AND chart_account_type_id IN (11,14) )
